visual.alt_text: Three-step Rhythm, Rhyme and Repetition organiser. Read: Compare rhythm performances. Notice: Identify repetition. Correct the student's mix-up using the full task.

answers.text: Keep “Both, because they began with the same written chant”; it uses a detail that sounds familiar.
Judge the pattern and control, not the speed alone.
Choose “Group B, because a faster performance has a stronger beat” instead; it sounds clearer.

explanation.summary: Judge the pattern and control, not the speed alone. A steady repeated beat reproduces the chant's rhythm more accurately.
explanation.hint: Check the whole example and decide which feedback addresses the exact mix-up.
